title: 第23章 深渊下的病人第24章 城主府的秘密任务
lines: 三道流光转瞬即至，落在林澈和白雨跟前。
为首的是个黑袍老者，面容阴鸷，金丹初期修为。
身后两人，一男一女，都是筑基后期。
他们衣着统一，胸口绣着一个诡异的徽记一只眼睛，瞳孔中有***术刀。
天机阁的标记！
“林澈，果然是你。”
黑袍老者冷笑道，“文执事说得对，你一定会来葬龙渊找龙血芝。
我们在此等候多时了。”
林澈将白雨护在身后，右手虚影艰难地凝聚。
之前的消耗还没恢复，虚影的光芒比平时黯淡了七成。
“天机阁真是阴魂不散。”
他随口说道。
黑袍老者冷冷地说“交出龙血芝，还有你在遗迹中得到的东西，或许能留你全尸。”
他目光落在林澈手中的逆鳞上，“哦？还有龙族逆鳞？收获不小啊。”
他眼中放出贪婪之光。
龙族逆鳞，即使在元婴修士眼中也是至宝。
“想要？自己来拿。”
林澈握紧逆鳞，暗中将一丝灵力注入其中，不是激发，而是“唤醒”
其中的龙魂印记。
逆鳞微微发热，传来龙魂的意念「小家伙，遇到麻烦了？」
「前辈，能否借力？」
「可以，但逆鳞中的力量只能用一次，你想好了？」
「想好了。
短暂的交流，只是暗地里在两者之间，别人根本看不出来。
黑袍老者显然不想给林澈时间，一挥手“拿下！”
身后的一男一女同时出手。
男修用的是飞剑，剑身赤红，带着灼热的气息，直刺林澈咽喉。
女修用的是长鞭，鞭身布满倒刺，挥舞间发出刺耳的破空声，卷向林澈双腿。
两人配合默契，显然是经常联手对敌。
林澈没有硬接，虚影羽翼展开，身形如鬼魅般闪避。
同时，他将逆鳞递给白雨“快！
启动传送阵！”
白雨浑身发力，不顾一切地冲向传送阵石台，将地火晶核和逆鳞放在核心的能量槽中。
黑袍老者见状，脸色一沉“想跑？做梦！”
他身形一晃，化作一道黑光，直扑传送阵。
金丹修士的速度快如闪电，林澈根本拦不住。
但就在黑袍老者即将触及传送阵的一瞬间，逆鳞突然爆发出刺目的暗金色光芒！
一声苍老的龙吟，从逆鳞中传出。
龙魂的虚影，在光芒中凝聚，虽然只是极小的一部分，像一个黑点，但那属于上古龙族的威压，依然让黑袍老者动作一滞。
content_en:
Three streams of light arrived in an instant and landed in front of Lin Che and Bai Yu.
The leader was an old man in black robes, with a sinister face and an early stage of Jindan cultivation.
The two people behind him, a man and a woman, were both in the late stages of foundation building.
They were uniformly dressed, with a strange emblem embroidered on their chests, one eye, and a magic knife in the pupil.
The mark of Tianji Pavilion!
"Lin Che, it is indeed you."
The old man in black robe sneered, "Deacon Wen is right, you will definitely come to Burial Dragon Abyss to find Dragon Blood Zhi.
We have been waiting here for a long time. "
Lin Che protected Bai Yu behind her, and the shadow on her right hand condensed with difficulty.
The previous consumption has not been restored, and the light of the shadow is 70% dimmer than usual.
"Tianji Pavilion is really haunted."
he said casually.
The old man in black robe said coldly, "Hand over the dragon blood mushroom and the things you got in the ruins. Maybe you can keep your whole body."
His eyes fell on the reverse scale in Lin Che's hand, "Oh? There are also dragon reverse scales? The harvest is not small."
Greed shone in his eyes.
The dragon's reverse scale is a treasure even in the eyes of Yuanying monks.
"Want it? Come and get it yourself."
Lin Che held Ni Lin tightly and secretly injected a trace of spiritual power into it, not to stimulate it, but to "awaken" it.
The dragon soul mark in it.
Ni Lin was slightly hot, and the dragon soul's thoughts came to him: "Little guy, are you in trouble?"
"Senior, can you lend me some help?"
"Okay, but the power in the reverse scale can only be used once. Have you thought about it?"
"Think about it.
The brief communication was just secretly between the two, and others couldn't see it at all.
The old man in black robe obviously didn't want to give Lin Che time, and waved his hand, "Take it! "
A man and a woman behind him took action at the same time.
The male cultivator used a flying sword. The sword's body was red, with a burning breath, and it pierced Lin Che's throat.
The female cultivator used a long whip. The whip was covered with barbs. It made a harsh sound when it was swung through the air and rolled towards Lin Che's legs.
The two of them worked well together and apparently often teamed up to fight against their enemies.
Lin Che did not force the attack, the phantom's wings spread out, and its figure dodged like a ghost.
At the same time, he handed Ni Lin to Bai Yu, "Quick!"
Activate the teleportation array! "
Bai Yu exerted all his strength and rushed to the teleportation formation stone platform desperately, placing the earth fire crystal core and reverse scale in the energy tank of the core.
When the old man in black robe saw this, his face darkened, "Want to run?" dream! "
His body swayed and turned into a black light, heading towards the teleportation array.
The speed of the golden elixir cultivator was as fast as lightning, and Lin Che couldn't stop him at all.
But just when the old man in black robe was about to touch the teleportation array, Ni Lin suddenly burst out with a dazzling dark golden light!
An old dragon roar came from Ni Lin.
The shadow of the dragon soul condensed in the light. Although it was only a very small part, like a black dot, the pressure belonging to the ancient dragon clan still made the black-robed old man's movements stagnant.
